key_insight: DFT-trained machine-learning force fields can reproduce the martensitic dynamics of Ni2MnGa, including soft phonons and nanotwinned modulated martensites, at scales inaccessible to direct DFT.
engineering_relevance: This enables near-DFT-accuracy simulation of magnetic shape-memory alloys across finite temperature and larger time scales, supporting design of faster and more reliable actuation materials.
method: Train machine-learning force fields on ab initio molecular dynamics data from DFT.
Run classical molecular dynamics to capture austenite-martensite transformation pathways.
Analyze phonons, twin boundaries, and nanotwin-mediated transformation behavior.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that the ML-FF reproduces key DFT features of Ni2MnGa, including the TA2 soft phonon and a preference for nanotwinned martensites, while also matching the predicted negative twin boundary energy along the transformation path.
watch_item: Accuracy depends on the quality and coverage of the DFT training data, so unseen transformation pathways or compositions may require retraining or validation.
paper_title: Modelling the dynamics of the martensitic transformation in Ni$_2$MnGa with machine-learning force-fields
